description: Header file defining the GenericV4L2Device class, which implements a V4L2 device interface for generic V4L2 video codec devices on platforms supporting them. It includes method declarations for device operations, device enumeration, and format support, as well as private members for device management.

classes.name: GenericV4L2Device
classes.description: A class implementing a generic V4L2 device interface for video codec operations, supporting device enumeration, buffer management, and format support.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a V4L2 device of a specified type and pixel format.

methods.name: Ioctl
methods.description: Performs an ioctl operation on the device.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Polls the device for events.

methods.name: SetDevicePollInterrupt
methods.description: Sets an interrupt for device polling.

methods.name: ClearDevicePollInterrupt
methods.description: Clears the poll interrupt.

methods.name: Mmap
methods.description: Memory maps a buffer.

methods.name: Munmap
methods.description: Unmaps a memory buffer.

methods.name: GetDmabufsForV4L2Buffer
methods.description: Retrieves DMA buffers for a V4L2 buffer.

methods.name: CanCreateEGLImageFrom
methods.description: Checks if an EGL image can be created from a given format.

methods.name: CreateEGLImage
methods.description: Creates an EGL image from a buffer.

methods.name: DestroyEGLImage
methods.description: Destroys an EGL image.

methods.name: GetTextureTarget
methods.description: Returns the texture target for the device.

methods.name: PreferredInputFormat
methods.description: Returns preferred input formats for a given device type.

methods.name: GetSupportedImageProcessorPixelformats
methods.description: Returns supported pixel formats for image processing.

methods.name: GetSupportedDecodeProfiles
methods.description: Returns supported decode profiles.

methods.name: GetSupportedEncodeProfiles
methods.description: Returns supported encode profiles.

methods.name: IsImageProcessingSupported
methods.description: Checks if image processing is supported.

methods.name: IsJpegDecodingSupported
methods.description: Checks if JPEG decoding is supported.

methods.name: IsJpegEncodingSupported
methods.description: Checks if JPEG encoding is supported.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the device.

methods.name: OpenDevicePath
methods.description: Opens a device node at a given path.

methods.name: CloseDevice
methods.description: Closes the currently open device.

methods.name: EnumerateDevicesForType
methods.description: Enumerates all devices of a specific type.

methods.name: GetDevicesForType
methods.description: Returns cached device info for a device type.

methods.name: GetDevicePathFor
methods.description: Returns device path supporting a specific pixel format.
